Arize AI is tracked here through 2 products, Arize AI and Arize Phoenix, rather than a single listed offering.

Arize AI, under ai governance & risk management platforms, is tagged with ML observability, LLM tracing, evaluation framework, and prompt monitoring. Arize Phoenix, under ai governance & risk management platforms, is tagged with source-available LLM observability built on OpenTelemetry and OpenInference and self-hostable tracing, evals, RAG metrics, embedding drift.

That the data separates Arize AI and Arize Phoenix into distinct entries rather than folding them into one product listing suggests each is tracked as its own surface area of the business. Beyond these tags and arize.com, the data carries no user counts, revenue, funding, or headcount for Arize AI, so nothing here supports a claim about the company's overall scale.
